header.label: Organisation
header.title: Structure
header.desc: OpenAEC consists of three parts that together carry the open source AEC ecosystem: the Foundation, OpenAEC Studio and the community.

foundation.title: OpenAEC Foundation being established
foundation.desc: The Foundation's goal is to maintain and safeguard the developed tools over the long term. It also builds a broad knowledge network for the construction sector — on a technical, software-technical and architectural level.
foundation.desc2: The aim is the widest possible coverage, so the sector as a whole benefits from open knowledge and open software.

studio.title: OpenAEC Studio
studio.desc: An IT consultancy that delivers services around the OpenAEC ecosystem: implementation, hosting, custom development and professional support.
studio.desc2: The software stays open source; Studio makes sure organisations can put it to work in practice.

community.title: Community
community.desc: A large group of people from the construction sector. They maintain their own repositories affiliated with the OpenAEC Foundation, or contribute to repositories that fall under OpenAEC.
community.desc2: The Foundation is also supported by partners and supporters who help make the development possible.

note: This structure is very much a work in progress — a lot is still being worked out. Want to think along or contribute? We'd love to hear from you.
